   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2d0f6dc9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Open Model\n",
    "\n",
    "The tutorial uses *Network 3*, a fictional district heating network shared by the mantle tutorials: a heat plant (in its own container \"Heizwerk\"), about 180 consumers, a ring road and two longitudinal sections, calculated over one day. It is built from scratch with the SIR 3S Toolkit by [Network3.py](https://github.com/3SConsult/sir3stoolkit/blob/main/docs/source/networks/Network3.py); `Network3.db3` is included in the tutorial's ZIP archive.\n",
    "\n",
    "Its elements have unique ID references (IDREFERENZ), e.g. `VL-HS-01` for the first supply pipe of the main street. They are used below to look up tks with [GetTkFromIDReference()](https://3sconsult.github.io/sir3stoolkit/references/sir3stoolkit.core.html#sir3stoolkit.core.wrapper.SIR3S_Model.GetTkFromIDReference) - the tks themselves differ between builds of the model."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "c2f6ab2c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.806759Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.805557Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.809796Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.809796Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "dbFilePath=r\"Network3.db3\""
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "efbe536c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.809796Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-25T15:27:08.809796Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-25T15:27:13.924739Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-25T15:27:13.924234Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[2026-11-25 16:27:13,921] INFO in sir3stoolkit.core.wrapper: Model is open for further operation\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "s3s.OpenModel(dbName=dbFilePath,\n",
    "              providerType=s3s.ProviderTypes.SQLite,\n",
    "              Mid=\"M-1-0-1\",\n",
    "              saveCurrentlyOpenModel=False,\n",
    "              namedInstance=\"\",\n",
    "              userID=\"\",\n",
    "              password=\"\")"
   ]
  },
